_comment: Story Stage character art ships as optional content packs rather than in the
repository. story_stage_sprites.py reads this file to build, publish and
install them. Sizes and checksums are written by `build --update-manifest`;
download_url is filled in by hand once the archive is attached to a release.
Paths are relative to `destination`, which is relative to the repository root.

packs.name: Ireti Okan — Awaiting an Awakening
packs.description: Character art for the Ireti Okan scenario. The smaller of the two packs, and the one to start with.

packs.name: Stochastic Dreams
packs.description: Character art for the Stochastic Dreams scenario, which has the largest cast and the most animation states.
